note: G30: Filtered MRR / Hits@1,3,10 external benchmark yardstick on FB15k-237 test split

controls.name: C1_planted_composition_upper_bound
controls.must_fire_because: a rule engine with valid inference must achieve MRR=1.0 on a planted composition
controls.can_fail_because: inference walk could miss multi-hop paths or fail filter verification
controls.null_must_contain: an unpredicted or incorrectly ranked query on a deterministic planted relation

controls.name: C2_empty_rule_lower_bound
controls.must_fire_because: an empty rule set must yield zero hits and MRR near random entity expectation
controls.can_fail_because: tie-breaking bug could assign rank 1 to unpredicted entities
controls.null_must_contain: non-zero hits when zero rules are provided

controls.name: C3_metric_monotonicity
controls.must_fire_because: Hits@1 <= Hits@3 <= Hits@10 must strictly hold across all models
controls.can_fail_because: metric calculation bug across different thresholds
controls.null_must_contain: a strict violation of Hits@K monotonicity

controls.name: C4_filter_integrity
controls.must_fire_because: filter sizes must never exceed total entity count and true target must not be filtered
controls.can_fail_because: corrupted set filtering or index boundary leak
controls.null_must_contain: an entity candidate pool larger than vocabulary size

falsifiers.name: F1_null_dominance
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Degree-preserving null rules achieve within 15% of real mined rules on Filtered MRR
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a null MRR within 15% of real MRR (ratio >= 0.85)
falsifiers.refutes: Real mined rules possess genuine relational link prediction capacity beyond degree sequences
falsifiers.fires_when: Degree-preserving null rules achieve within 15% of real mined rules on Filtered MRR
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_top12_heuristic_inversion
falsifiers.can_fail_because: Ranking rule sets by top-12 confidence inverts relative to Filtered MRR
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a discordance between top-12 rule confidence order and test-split link prediction MRR
falsifiers.refutes: Top-12 mean confidence is a reliable proxy for whole-graph link prediction utility
falsifiers.fires_when: Ranking rule sets by top-12 confidence inverts relative to Filtered MRR

falsifier: Degree-preserving null matches real mined rules within 15% on Filtered MRR, or top-12 ranking inverts vs Filtered MRR
